`Oxylus/src/Render/Shaders/passes/rmvsm_debug.slang`:

```slang
import common;
import gpu;
import scene;
import rmvsm;

#include <fullscreen.slang>

[[vk::binding(0)]] ConstantBuffer<Camera> camera;
[[vk::binding(1)]] StructuredBuffer<VirtualClipmap> clipmaps;
[[vk::binding(2)]] Texture2D<f32> depth_image;
[[vk::binding(3)]] Texture2D<f32x4> normal_image;
[[vk::binding(4)]] Texture2DArray<u32> vsm_page_table;

func hsv_to_rgb(f32x3 hsv) -> f32x3 {
    let n = f32x3(5.0, 3.0, 1.0);
    let k = (n + hsv.x / 1.0471975512) % 6.0;
    return hsv.z - hsv.z * hsv.y * max(f32x3(0.0), min(k, min(4.0 - k, f32x3(1.0))));
}
[[shader("fragment")]]
func fs_main(
    VertexOutput input,
    uniform VSMContext vsm_ctx
) -> f32x4 {
    let pixel_pos = i32x3(i32x2(input.position.xy), 0);
    let depth = depth_image.Load(pixel_pos);
    if (depth == 0.0) {
        return 1.0;
    }

    let mapped_smooth_normal = normal_image.Load(pixel_pos);
    let flat_N = normalize(com::oct_to_vec3(mapped_smooth_normal.ba));

    let NDC = f32x3(input.tex_coord * 2.0 - 1.0, depth);
    let world_position_h = mul(camera.inv_projection_view, f32x4(NDC, 1.0));
    let world_position = world_position_h.xyz / world_position_h.w;

    let clipmap_index = i32(vsm_ctx.get_clipmap_index(camera, input.tex_coord, depth));
    let clipmap = clipmaps[clipmap_index];
    let clipmap_info = clipmap.get_clipmap_info(world_position);

    let virt_coords = clipmap_info.get_virt_coords(vsm_ctx.get_page_table_extent().xy);
    let wrapped_coords = vsm_ctx.page_coords_virtual_to_wrapped(virt_coords, clipmap.page_offset);
    let page = VSMPageMetadata(vsm_page_table.Load(i32x4(wrapped_coords, clipmap_index, 0)));
    let physical_page_coords = i32x2(page.get_physical_coords(vsm_ctx.physcial_page_table_size, vsm_ctx.page_size));
    let phys_texel = clipmap_info.get_virt_coords(vsm_ctx.get_physical_page_table_extent().xy);
    let in_page_texel = i32x2(com::mod(f32x2(phys_texel), f32x2(vsm_ctx.page_size)));
    let physical_texel_coord = physical_page_coords * vsm_ctx.page_size + in_page_texel;
    let near_border = any(in_page_texel < 2) || any(in_page_texel > vsm_ctx.page_size - 2);

    // page border highlighting
    if (near_border) {
      let line_hsv = f32x3(f32(clipmap_index) / f32(vsm_ctx.clipmap_count + 1) * TAU, 1.0, 0.5);
      let clipmap_color = hsv_to_rgb(line_hsv);
      return f32x4(clipmap_color, 1.0);
    }

    if (!page.is_backed() && page.is_visible()) {
      return f32x4(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    }

    let page_status = f32x3(f32(page.is_backed()), f32(page.is_dirty()), f32(page.is_visible()));
    return f32x4(page_status, 1.0);
}
```

`Oxylus/src/Render/Shaders/passes/rmvsm_downsample_hpb.slang`:

```slang
import common;
import gpu;
import rmvsm;

[[vk::constant_id(0)]] const bool IS_FIRST_PASS = false;
[[vk::binding(0)]] Texture2DArray<u32> virtual_page_table;
[[vk::binding(1)]] Texture2DArray<u8> src_hpb;
[[vk::binding(2)]] RWTexture2DArray<u8, ImageFormat::R8UI> dst_hpb;

[[shader("compute")]]
[[numthreads(16, 16, 1)]]
func cs_main(
    u32x3 thread_id : SV_DispatchThreadID,
    uniform u32x3 dst_extent,
) -> void {
    if (any(thread_id >= dst_extent)) {
        return;
    }

    var cached = false;
    if (IS_FIRST_PASS) {
        let page = VSMPageMetadata(virtual_page_table.Load(u32x4(thread_id, 0)));
        cached = page.is_visible() && page.is_backed() && page.is_dirty();
    } else {
        let tl = src_hpb.Load(i32x4(thread_id.xy * 2 + i32x2(0, 0), thread_id.z, 0));
        let tr = src_hpb.Load(i32x4(thread_id.xy * 2 + i32x2(0, 1), thread_id.z, 0));
        let bl = src_hpb.Load(i32x4(thread_id.xy * 2 + i32x2(1, 0), thread_id.z, 0));
        let br = src_hpb.Load(i32x4(thread_id.xy * 2 + i32x2(1, 1), thread_id.z, 0));
        cached = (tl | tr | bl | br) == 1;
    }

    dst_hpb.Store(thread_id, cached);
}
```

`Oxylus/src/Render/Shaders/passes/rmvsm_draw_physical_pages.slang`:

```slang
import common;
import gpu;
import scene;
import visbuffer;
import rmvsm;

[[vk::binding(0)]] StructuredBuffer<Mesh> meshes;
[[vk::binding(1)]] StructuredBuffer<MeshInstance> mesh_instances;
[[vk::binding(2)]] StructuredBuffer<MeshletInstance> meshlet_instances;
[[vk::binding(3)]] StructuredBuffer<TransformWorld> transforms;
[[vk::binding(4)]] StructuredBuffer<Material> materials;
[[vk::binding(5)]] StructuredBuffer<VirtualClipmap> clipmaps;
[[vk::binding(6)]] Texture2DArray<u32> page_tables;
[[vk::binding(7)]] RWTexture2D<u32, 1, ImageFormat::R32UI> physical_pages;

[[vk::push_constant]] VSMContext ctx;

struct VertexOutput {
    f32x4 position : SV_Position;
    f32x2 tex_coord : TEXCOORD;
    nointerpolation u32 material_index;
};

[[shader("vertex")]]
func vs_main(u32 vertex_index : SV_VertexID) -> VertexOutput {
    let vis = VisBufferData(vertex_index);
    let meshlet_instance = meshlet_instances[vis.meshlet_instance_index];
    let mesh_instance = mesh_instances[meshlet_instance.mesh_instance_index];
    let mesh = meshes[mesh_instance.mesh_index];
    let mesh_lod = mesh.lods[mesh_instance.lod_index];
    let transform = transforms[mesh_instance.transform_index];
    let meshlet = mesh_lod.meshlets[meshlet_instance.meshlet_index];

    let index = meshlet.index(mesh_lod, vis.triangle_index);
    let vertex_pos = meshlet.position(mesh, index);
    let tex_coord = meshlet.tex_coord(mesh, index);
    let world_pos = transform.to_world_position(vertex_pos);

    let projection_view_mat = clipmaps[ctx.curr_clipmap_index].projection_view_mat;
    let clip_pos = mul(projection_view_mat, f32x4(world_pos.xyz, 1.0));

    VertexOutput output;
    output.position = clip_pos;
    output.tex_coord = tex_coord;
    output.material_index = mesh_instance.material_index;

    return output;
}

[[shader("fragment")]]
func fs_main(VertexOutput input) -> void {
    let clipmap = clipmaps[ctx.curr_clipmap_index];
    let page_offset = clipmap.page_offset;

    let virtual_uv = input.position.xy / ctx.get_physical_page_table_extent().xy;
    let virt_coords = i32x2(floor(virtual_uv * ctx.get_page_table_extent().xy));
    let wrapped_coords = ctx.page_coords_virtual_to_wrapped(virt_coords, page_offset);
    let page_address = i32x3(wrapped_coords, ctx.curr_clipmap_index);
    let page = VSMPageMetadata(page_tables.Load(i32x4(page_address, 0)));
    if (page.is_backed() && page.is_dirty()) {
        let physical_page_coords = page.get_physical_coords(ctx.physcial_page_table_size, ctx.page_size);
        let virtual_texel_coord = i32x2(floor(virtual_uv * ctx.physcial_page_table_size));
        let in_page_texel_coord = i32x2(com::mod(f32x2(virtual_texel_coord), f32x2(ctx.page_size)));
        let in_memory_offset = physical_page_coords * ctx.page_size;
        let physical_texel_coord = in_memory_offset + in_page_texel_coord;

#if 1
        let material = materials[input.material_index];
        if (material.flags & MaterialFlag::HasAlbedoImage) {
            UVGradient grad;
            grad.uv = input.tex_coord;
            grad.ddx = ddx(input.tex_coord);
            grad.ddy = ddy(input.tex_coord);
            let alpha_color = material.sample_albedo_color(grad).a;

            if (alpha_color < clamp(material.get_alpha_cutoff(), 0.001, 1.0)) {
                return;
            }
        }
#endif
        __atomic_min(physical_pages[physical_texel_coord], asuint(input.position.z / input.position.w));
    }
}
```

`Oxylus/src/Render/Shaders/passes/rmvsm_free_invisible_pages.slang`:

```slang
import common;
import gpu;
import rmvsm;

struct ShaderParameters {
    RWTexture2DArray<u32, ImageFormat::R32UI> page_tables;
};

[[shader("compute")]]
[[numthreads(16, 16, 1)]]
func cs_main(
    u32x3 thread_id : SV_DispatchThreadID,
    uniform ParameterBlock<ShaderParameters> params,
    uniform VSMContext ctx
) -> void {
    if (any(thread_id.xy >= ctx.get_page_table_extent().xy)) {
        return;
    }

    var page = VSMPageMetadata(params.page_tables.Load(thread_id));
    if (!page.is_visible() && page.is_backed()) {
        page.set_backed(false);
        params.page_tables.Store(thread_id, page.data);
    }
}
```

`Oxylus/src/Render/Shaders/passes/rmvsm_invalidate_pages.slang`:

```slang
import common;
import gpu;
import rmvsm;
import scene;
import cull;

#include <defines.slang>

[[vk::binding(0)]] RWTexture2DArray<u32, ImageFormat::R32UI> page_table;
[[vk::binding(1)]] StructuredBuffer<u32> dirty_mesh_instance_indices;
[[vk::binding(2)]] StructuredBuffer<MeshInstance> mesh_instances;
[[vk::binding(3)]] StructuredBuffer<Mesh> meshes;
[[vk::binding(4)]] StructuredBuffer<TransformWorld> transforms;
[[vk::binding(5)]] StructuredBuffer<VirtualClipmap> clipmaps;
[[vk::binding(6)]] StructuredBuffer<TransformPrevious> transforms_previous;

constexpr static u32 INVALIDATE_PAGE_BLOCK_RESOLUTION = 8;

func invalidate_in_section(
    f32x4x4 mvp,
    f32 near,
    f32x3 aabb_center,
    f32x3 aabb_extent,
    i32x2 section_min,
    i32x2 section_max,
    i32 clipmap_index,
    VSMContext ctx,
    VirtualClipmap clipmap
) -> void {
    if (let screen_aabb = project_aabb(mvp, near, aabb_center, aabb_extent)) {
        let uv_min = clamp(screen_aabb.min.xy, 0.0, 1.0);
        let uv_max = clamp(screen_aabb.max.xy, 0.0, 1.0);
        if (any(uv_min >= uv_max)) {
            return;
        }

        let limits = i32x4(i32x2(0), i32x2(ctx.page_table_size - 1));
        let page_min = clamp(i32x2(floor(uv_min * f32(ctx.page_table_size))),    limits.xy, limits.zw);
        let page_max = clamp(i32x2(ceil(uv_max * f32(ctx.page_table_size))) - 1, limits.xy, limits.zw);

        let intersect_min = max(page_min, section_min);
        let intersect_max = min(page_max, section_max);
        if (any(intersect_min > intersect_max)) {
            return;
        }

        for (var y = intersect_min.y; y <= intersect_max.y; y++) {
            for (var x = intersect_min.x; x <= intersect_max.x; x++) {
                let wrapped_page = ctx.page_coords_virtual_to_wrapped(i32x2(x, y), clipmap.page_offset);
                if (any(wrapped_page == i32x2(INVALID_COORDS))) {
                    continue;
                }

                let page_address = i32x3(wrapped_page, clipmap_index);
                var page = VSMPageMetadata(page_table.Load(page_address));
                if (page.is_backed()) {
                    page.reset();
                    page.set_invalidated(true);
                    page_table.Store(page_address, page.data);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

[[shader("compute")]]
[[numthreads(1, INVALIDATE_PAGES_WORKGROUP_Y, 1)]]
func cs_main(
    u32x3 thread_id: SV_DispatchThreadID,
    uniform VSMContext ctx
) -> void {
    let mesh_index = thread_id.x;
    let section_index = thread_id.y;
    let clipmap_index = thread_id.z;

    if (clipmap_index >= ctx.clipmap_count) {
      return;
    }

    let sections_per_dim = ctx.page_table_size / i32(INVALIDATE_PAGE_BLOCK_RESOLUTION);
    let section_x = i32(section_index) % sections_per_dim;
    let section_y = i32(section_index) / sections_per_dim;
    if (section_x >= sections_per_dim || section_y >= sections_per_dim) {
      return;
    }

    let section_min = i32x2(section_x, section_y) * i32(INVALIDATE_PAGE_BLOCK_RESOLUTION);
    let section_max = section_min + i32(INVALIDATE_PAGE_BLOCK_RESOLUTION - 1);

    let mesh_instance = mesh_instances[dirty_mesh_instance_indices[mesh_index]];
    let transform = transforms[mesh_instance.transform_index];
    let transform_previous = transforms_previous[mesh_instance.transform_index];
    let mesh = meshes[mesh_instance.mesh_index];
    let clipmap = clipmaps[clipmap_index];

    let mvp_prev = mul(clipmap.projection_view_mat, transform_previous.previous_world);
    invalidate_in_section(
      mvp_prev, clipmap.z_near,
      mesh.bounds.aabb_center, mesh.bounds.aabb_extent,
      section_min, section_max,
      i32(clipmap_index), ctx, clipmap
    );

    let mvp_curr = mul(clipmap.projection_view_mat, transform.world);
    invalidate_in_section(
      mvp_curr, clipmap.z_near,
      mesh.bounds.aabb_center, mesh.bounds.aabb_extent,
      section_min, section_max,
      i32(clipmap_index), ctx, clipmap
    );
}
```

`Oxylus/src/Render/Shaders/passes/rmvsm_mark_dirty_pages.slang`:

```slang
import common;
import gpu;
import rmvsm;

struct ShaderParameters {
    Texture2DArray<u32> page_tables;

    RWStructuredBuffer<DispatchIndirectCommand> clear_cmd;
    RWStructuredBuffer<VSMPageAllocator> allocator;
};

[[shader("compute")]]
[[numthreads(16, 16, 1)]]
func cs_main(
    u32x3 thread_id : SV_DispatchThreadID,
    uniform ParameterBlock<ShaderParameters> params,
    uniform VSMContext ctx
) -> void {
    if (any(thread_id.xy >= ctx.get_page_table_extent().xy)) {
        return;
    }

    var page = VSMPageMetadata(params.page_tables.Load(i32x4(thread_id, 0)));
    if (page.is_backed() && page.is_dirty()) {
        push_dirty_physical_page(params.allocator[0], page.get_physical_coords(ctx.physcial_page_table_size, ctx.page_size));
        __atomic_add(params.clear_cmd[0].z, 1, MemoryOrder::Relaxed);
    }
}
```

`Oxylus/src/Render/Shaders/passes/rmvsm_mark_visible_pages.slang`:

```slang
import common;
import gpu;
import scene;
import rmvsm;

struct ShaderParameters {
    ConstantBuffer<Camera> camera;
    StructuredBuffer<VirtualClipmap> clipmaps;

    Texture2D<f32> depth_image;

    RWTexture2DArray<u32, ImageFormat::R32UI> page_tables;
    RWStructuredBuffer<u32> page_occupancy;
    RWStructuredBuffer<VSMPageAllocator> allocator;
};

groupshared VirtualClipmap shared_clipmaps[10];


[[shader("compute")]]
[[numthreads(16, 16, 1)]]
func cs_main(
    u32x2 thread_id : SV_DispatchThreadID,
    u32 group_index : SV_GroupIndex,
    uniform ParameterBlock<ShaderParameters> params,
    uniform VSMContext ctx
) -> void {
    if (group_index < 10) {
        shared_clipmaps[group_index] = params.clipmaps[group_index];
    }

    GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();

    if (any(thread_id >= u32x2(ctx.depth_extent))) {
        return;
    }

    let depth = params.depth_image.Load(i32x3(thread_id, 0));
    if (depth == 0.0) {
        return;
    }

    let uv = (f32x2(thread_id.xy) + 0.5) / f32x2(ctx.depth_extent);
    let world_pos = params.camera.unproject_uv(uv, depth);

    let clipmap_index = ctx.get_clipmap_index(params.camera, uv, depth);
    let clipmap = shared_clipmaps[clipmap_index];
    let clipmap_info = clipmap.get_clipmap_info(world_pos);
    let virt_coords = clipmap_info.get_virt_coords(ctx.get_page_table_extent().xy);
    let wrapped_coords = ctx.page_coords_virtual_to_wrapped(virt_coords, clipmap.page_offset);
    let page_table_address = i32x3(wrapped_coords, i32(clipmap_index));

    // scalarization loop in listing 3.3
    var first_thread_visible = all(wrapped_coords >= 0);
    var done = false;
    while (!done) {
        let subgroup_address = WaveReadLaneFirst(page_table_address);
        if (all(subgroup_address == page_table_address)) {
            if (WaveIsFirstLane()) {
                first_thread_visible = true;
            }
            done = true;
        }
    }

    if (first_thread_visible) {
        let prev_page_data = __atomic_or(params.page_tables[page_table_address], u32(VSMPageState.Visible), MemoryOrder::Relaxed);
        let prev_page = VSMPageMetadata(prev_page_data);

        if (!prev_page.is_visible()) {
            // page became visible this frame

            if (prev_page.is_backed()) {
                // we already have allocated this page, and it was marked visible
                // keep track of visible and backed pages so the allocator wont overwrite it
                let physical_address = prev_page.get_physical_address();
                params.page_occupancy[physical_address] = 1u;
            } else {
                let alloc_request = VSMAllocRequest(page_table_address);
                push_page_alloc_request(params.allocator[0], alloc_request);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`Oxylus/src/Render/Shaders/passes/sky_aerial_perspective.slang`:

```slang
module sky_aerial_perspective;

import common;
import gpu;
import sky;
import scene;

struct ShaderParameters {
    Sampler sampler;
    Image2D<f32x4> sky_transmittance_lut;
    Image2D<f32x4> sky_multiscattering_lut;
    ConstantBuffer<Atmosphere> atmosphere;
    ConstantBuffer<Camera> camera;
    StorageImage3D<f32x4, ImageFormat::RGBA16F> sky_aerial_perspective_lut;
};

[[shader("compute")]]
[[numthreads(16, 16, 1)]]
func cs_main(
    u32x3 thread_id : SV_DispatchThreadID,
    uniform ParameterBlock<ShaderParameters> params,
    uniform f32x3 sun_dir,
    uniform f32 sun_intensity,
) -> void {
    const let lut_size = params.atmosphere.aerial_perspective_lut_size;
    let uv = f32x2(f32x2(thread_id.xy) + 0.5) / f32x2(lut_size.xy);
    let clip_space = f32x3(2.0 * uv - 1.0, 1.0);
    let world_space = mul(params.camera.inv_projection_view, f32x4(clip_space, 1.0));
    let world_pos = world_space.xyz / world_space.w;
    let world_dir = normalize(world_pos - params.camera.position.xyz);
    var eye_pos = params.atmosphere.get_eye_pos(params.camera.position.xyz);

    var slice = ((f32(thread_id.z) + 0.5) * (1.0 / lut_size.z));
    slice *= slice;
    slice *= lut_size.z;

    let step_count = int(max(1.0, f32(thread_id.z + 1.0) * 2.0));
    let per_slice_depth = f32(lut_size.x / lut_size.z);
    let start_depth = params.atmosphere.aerial_perspective_start_km * INV_CAMERA_SCALE_UNIT;
    let t_max = slice * per_slice_depth;

    let start_pos = eye_pos + start_depth * world_dir;
    let ray_pos = start_pos + t_max * world_dir;
    var view_height = length(ray_pos);

    // if (view_height <= (params.atmosphere.planet_radius + PLANET_RADIUS_OFFSET)) {
    //     ray_pos = normalize(ray_pos) * (params.atmosphere.planet_radius + PLANET_RADIUS_OFFSET);
    //     world_dir = normalize(ray_pos - eye_pos);
    //     t_max = length(ray_pos - eye_pos);
    // }

    f32 t_max_max = t_max;
    view_height = length(eye_pos);
    if (view_height >= params.atmosphere.atmos_radius) {
        f32x3 prev_ray_pos = eye_pos;
        if (!move_to_top_atmosphere(eye_pos, world_dir, params.atmosphere.atmos_radius)) {
            params.sky_aerial_perspective_lut.Store(thread_id, 0.0);
            return;
        }
        f32 length_to_atmosphere = length(prev_ray_pos - eye_pos);
        if (t_max_max < length_to_atmosphere) {
            params.sky_aerial_perspective_lut.Store(thread_id, 0.0);
            return;
        }

        t_max_max = max(0.0, t_max_max - length_to_atmosphere);
     }

    AtmosphereIntegrateInfo info = {};
    info.eye_pos = eye_pos;
    info.eye_dir = world_dir;
    info.sun_dir = sun_dir;
    info.sun_intensity = sun_intensity;
    info.eval_planet_luminance = false;
    info.step_count = max(1.0, (f32(thread_id.z) + 1.0) * 2.0);
    info.t_max = t_max_max;
    let result = integrate_single_scattered_luminance(
            info, params.atmosphere, params.sampler, params.sky_transmittance_lut, params.sky_multiscattering_lut);
    params.sky_aerial_perspective_lut.Store(thread_id, f32x4(result.luminance, dot(result.transmittance, f32x3(1.0 / 3.0))));
}
```

`Oxylus/src/Render/Shaders/passes/sky_ibl.slang`:

```slang
module sky_ibl;

import common;
import gpu;
import sky;
import scene;

#define IBL_CUBE_RES 32
#define IBL_SAMPLES_PER_FRAME 64

typealias RWTextureCube<T:ITexelElement=float4, let sampleCount:int=0, let format:int=0> = _Texture<T, __ShapeCube, 0, 0, sampleCount, 1, 0, 0, format>;

struct ShaderParameters {
    Sampler sampler;
    Image2D<f32x4> sky_view_lut;
    Image2D<f32x4> sky_transmittance_lut;
    ConstantBuffer<Camera> camera;
    RWTextureCube<f32x4> ibl_cube;
};

mat3 CUBE_MAP_FACE_ROTATION(uint face) {
    switch (face) {
        case 0: return mat3(+0, +0, -1, +0, -1, +0, -1, +0, +0);
        case 1: return mat3(+0, +0, +1, +0, -1, +0, +1, +0, +0);
        case 2: return mat3(+1, +0, +0, +0, +0, -1, +0, +1, +0);
        case 3: return mat3(+1, +0, +0, +0, +0, +1, +0, -1, +0);
        case 4: return mat3(+1, +0, +0, +0, -1, +0, +0, +0, -1);
        default: return mat3(-1, +0, +0, +0, -1, +0, +0, +0, +1);
    }
}

func radical_inverse_vdc(u32 bits) -> f32 {
    bits = (bits << 16u) | (bits >> 16u);
    bits = ((bits & 0x55555555u) << 1u) | ((bits & 0xAAAAAAAAu) >> 1u);
    bits = ((bits & 0x33333333u) << 2u) | ((bits & 0xCCCCCCCCu) >> 2u);
    bits = ((bits & 0x0F0F0F0Fu) << 4u) | ((bits & 0xF0F0F0F0u) >> 4u);
    bits = ((bits & 0x00FF00FFu) << 8u) | ((bits & 0xFF00FF00u) >> 8u);
    return f32(bits) * 2.3283064365386963e-10;
}

func interleaved_gradient_noise(f32x2 p) -> f32 {
    let magic = f32x3(0.06711056, 0.00583715, 52.9829189);
    return frac(magic.z * frac(dot(p, magic.xy)));
}

func cosine_hemisphere_sample(u32 i, u32 sample_count, f32 rotation) -> f32x3 {
    let u1 = (f32(i) + 0.5) / f32(sample_count);
    let u2 = frac(radical_inverse_vdc(i) + rotation);
    let r = sqrt(u1);
    let phi = TAU * u2;
    return f32x3(r * cos(phi), r * sin(phi), sqrt(max(0.0, 1.0 - u1)));
}

[[shader("compute")]]
[[numthreads(8, 8, 1)]]
func cs_main(
    u32x3 thread_id : SV_DispatchThreadID,
    uniform ParameterBlock<ShaderParameters> params,
    uniform Atmosphere *atmosphere,
    uniform f32x3 sun_dir,
    uniform f32 sun_intensity,
    uniform f32 sun_ambient_strength,
    uniform u32 frame_index,
) -> void {
    let face = thread_id.z;
    let pixel = thread_id.xy;
    let uv = (f32x2(pixel) + 0.5) / f32(IBL_CUBE_RES);
    let output_dir = normalize(mul(CUBE_MAP_FACE_ROTATION(face), f32x3(uv * 2.0 - 1.0, -1.0)));

    let eye_pos = atmosphere.get_eye_pos(params.camera.position.xyz);

    let up = abs(output_dir.y) < 0.999 ? f32x3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0) : f32x3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
    let tangent = normalize(cross(up, output_dir));
    let bitangent = cross(output_dir, tangent);

    let history = params.ibl_cube.Load(i32x3(pixel, face));
    let has_history = history.a > 0.0;

    let base_rotation = interleaved_gradient_noise(f32x2(pixel) + f32(face) * f32x2(37.0, 17.0));
    let rotation = has_history
        ? frac(base_rotation + f32(frame_index) * 0.61803398875)
        : base_rotation;

    f32x3 frame_sum = 0.0;
    for (u32 i = 0; i < IBL_SAMPLES_PER_FRAME; i++) {
        let local = cosine_hemisphere_sample(i, IBL_SAMPLES_PER_FRAME, rotation);
        let input_dir = normalize(local.x * tangent + local.y * bitangent + local.z * output_dir);
        let sample = get_atmosphere_illuminance_along_ray(
            atmosphere,
            params.sampler,
            params.sky_view_lut,
            sun_dir,
            eye_pos,
            input_dir
        );

        frame_sum += sample;
    }
    let frame_estimate = frame_sum / f32(IBL_SAMPLES_PER_FRAME);

    let sun_cos_zenith = dot(sun_dir, f32x3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0));
    let transmittance_uv = transmittance_params_to_lut_uv(
        atmosphere.atmos_radius,
        atmosphere.planet_radius,
        f32x2(eye_pos.y, sun_cos_zenith));
    let sun_color = params.sky_transmittance_lut.SampleLevel(params.sampler, transmittance_uv, 0.0).rgb;
    let sun_facing = saturate(dot(output_dir, sun_dir));
    let sun_term = sun_ambient_strength * sun_color * sun_intensity * sun_facing / PI;

    let frame_result = frame_estimate + sun_term;

    let alpha = 0.02;
    let accumulated = has_history ? lerp(history.rgb, frame_result, alpha) : frame_result;

    params.ibl_cube.Store(i32x3(pixel, face), f32x4(accumulated, 1.0));
}
```

`Oxylus/src/Render/Shaders/passes/sky_multiscattering.slang`:

```slang
module sky_multiscattering;

import common;
import gpu;
import sky;
import scene;

import embedded.hemisphere;

struct ShaderParameters {
    Sampler sampler;
    Image2D<f32x4> sky_transmittance_lut;
    StorageImage2D<f32x4, ImageFormat::RGBA16F> sky_multiscattering_lut;
    ConstantBuffer<Atmosphere> atmosphere;
};

#define SAMPLE_COUNT 64

[[shader("compute")]]
[[numthreads(16, 16, 1)]]
func cs_main(
    u32x3 thread_id : SV_DispatchThreadID,
    uniform ParameterBlock<ShaderParameters> params
) -> void {
    f32x2 uv = f32x2(f32x2(thread_id.xy) + 0.5) / f32x2(params.atmosphere.multiscattering_lut_size.xy);

    const f32 atmosphere_thickness = params.atmosphere.atmos_radius - params.atmosphere.planet_radius;
    const f32 altitude = params.atmosphere.planet_radius + uv.y * atmosphere_thickness + PLANET_RADIUS_OFFSET;

    f32 sun_cos_theta = uv.x * 2.0 - 1.0;
    f32x3 sun_dir = f32x3(0.0, sun_cos_theta, com::safe_sqrt(1.0 - sun_cos_theta * sun_cos_theta));
    f32x3 ray_pos = f32x3(0.0, altitude, 0.0);

    AtmosphereIntegrateInfo info = {};
    info.eye_pos = ray_pos;
    info.sun_dir = sun_dir;
    info.eval_multiscattering = false;
    info.eval_planet_luminance = true;
    info.step_count = 32;

    f32x3 luminance = 0.0;
    f32x3 multi_scattering_as_1 = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < SAMPLE_COUNT; i++) {
        info.eye_dir = HEMISPHERE_64[i];
        const let result = integrate_single_scattered_luminance(info, params.atmosphere, params.sampler, params.sky_transmittance_lut, params.sky_transmittance_lut);
        multi_scattering_as_1 += result.multiscattering_as_1;
        luminance += result.luminance;
    }

    const let sphere_solid_angle = 4.0f * PI;
    const let isotropic_phase = 1.0f / sphere_solid_angle;
    const let inv_sample_count = 1.0 / f32(SAMPLE_COUNT);
    luminance *= sphere_solid_angle * inv_sample_count;
    multi_scattering_as_1 *= inv_sample_count;
    f32x3 scattered_luminance = luminance * isotropic_phase;
    f32x3 f_ms = 1.0 / (1.0 - multi_scattering_as_1);

    params.sky_multiscattering_lut.Store(thread_id.xy, f32x4(scattered_luminance * f_ms, 1.0));
}
```

`Oxylus/src/Render/Shaders/passes/sky_transmittance.slang`:

```slang
module sky_transmittance;

import common;
import gpu;
import sky;
import scene;

struct ShaderParameters {
    StorageImage2D<f32x4, ImageFormat::RGBA16F> sky_transmittance_lut;
    ConstantBuffer<Atmosphere> atmosphere;
};

[[shader("compute")]]
[[numthreads(16, 16, 1)]]
func cs_main(
    u32x3 thread_id : SV_DispatchThreadID,
    uniform ParameterBlock<ShaderParameters> params
) -> void {
    f32x2 uv = f32x2(f32x2(thread_id.xy) + 0.5) / f32x2(params.atmosphere.transmittance_lut_size.xy);
    f32 h = com::safe_sqrt(
        params.atmosphere.atmos_radius * params.atmosphere.atmos_radius -
        params.atmosphere.planet_radius * params.atmosphere.planet_radius);
    f32 rho = h * uv.y;
    f32 lut_x = sqrt(rho * rho + params.atmosphere.planet_radius * params.atmosphere.planet_radius);
    f32 d_min = params.atmosphere.atmos_radius - lut_x;
    f32 d_max = rho + h;
    f32 d = d_min + uv.x * (d_max - d_min);
    f32 lut_y = d == 0.0 ? 1.0 : (h * h - rho * rho - d * d) / (2.0 * lut_x * d);
    lut_y = clamp(lut_y, -1.0, 1.0);

    f32x3 sun_dir = f32x3(0.0, sqrt(1.0 - lut_y * lut_y), lut_y);
    f32x3 ray_pos = f32x3(0.0, 0.0, lut_x);

    const f32 STEP_COUNT = 1000.0;
    f32 distance = com::ray_sphere_intersect_nearest(ray_pos, sun_dir, params.atmosphere.atmos_radius).value;
    f32 distance_per_step = distance / STEP_COUNT;
    f32x3 optical_depth = 0.0;
    for (f32 i = 0.0; i < STEP_COUNT; i += 1.0) {
        ray_pos += sun_dir * distance_per_step;
        let ray_altitude = length(ray_pos) - params.atmosphere.planet_radius;
        const let medium = MediumScattering(params.atmosphere, ray_altitude);
        optical_depth += medium.extinction_sum * distance_per_step;
    }

    params.sky_transmittance_lut.Store(thread_id.xy, f32x4(exp(-optical_depth), 1.0));
}
```

`Oxylus/src/Render/Shaders/passes/sky_view.slang`:

```slang
module sky_view;

import common;
import gpu;
import sky;
import scene;

struct ShaderParameters {
    Sampler sampler;
    Image2D<f32x4> sky_transmittance_lut;
    Image2D<f32x4> sky_multiscattering_lut;
    ConstantBuffer<Atmosphere> atmosphere;
    StorageImage2D<f32x4, ImageFormat::RGBA16F> sky_view_lut;
};

[[shader("compute")]]
[[numthreads(16, 16, 1)]]
func cs_main(
    u32x3 thread_id : SV_DispatchThreadID,
    uniform ParameterBlock<ShaderParameters> params,
    uniform f32x3 sun_dir,
    uniform f32 sun_intensity,
    uniform f32x3 camera_pos,
) {
    let uv = f32x2(thread_id.xy) / f32x2(params.atmosphere.sky_view_lut_size.xy);
    var eye_pos = params.atmosphere.get_eye_pos(camera_pos);

    let h = length(eye_pos);
    let eye_dir = uv_to_sky_view_lut_params(params.atmosphere, uv, h);

    if (!move_to_top_atmosphere(eye_pos, eye_dir, params.atmosphere.atmos_radius)) {
        params.sky_view_lut.Store(thread_id.xy, 0.0);
        return;
    }

    let up_vec = eye_pos / h;
    let sun_zenith_cos_angle = dot(sun_dir, up_vec);
    let sun_dir = normalize(f32x3(com::safe_sqrt(1.0 - sun_zenith_cos_angle * sun_zenith_cos_angle), sun_zenith_cos_angle, 0.0));

    AtmosphereIntegrateInfo info = {};
    info.eye_pos = eye_pos;
    info.eye_dir = eye_dir;
    info.sun_dir = sun_dir;
    info.sun_intensity = sun_intensity;
    info.step_count = 48;

    let result = integrate_single_scattered_luminance(info, params.atmosphere, params.sampler, params.sky_transmittance_lut, params.sky_multiscattering_lut);
    let inv_luminance = 1.0 / max(result.luminance, float3(1.0 / 1048576.0));
    let inv_mult = min(1048576.0, max(inv_luminance.x, max(inv_luminance.y, inv_luminance.z)));

    params.sky_view_lut.Store(thread_id.xy, f32x4(result.luminance * inv_mult, 1.0 / inv_mult));
}
```

`Oxylus/src/Render/Shaders/passes/tonemap.slang`:

```slang
import common;

    PostProcessSettings post_process_settings;

struct VertexOutput {
    f32x4 position : SV_Position;
    f32x2 tex_coord : TEXCOORD;
};

[[shader("vertex")]]
VertexOutput vs_main(u32 vertex_id : SV_VertexID) {
    VertexOutput output;
    output.tex_coord = f32x2((vertex_id << 1) & 2, vertex_id & 2);
    output.position = f32x4(2.0 * output.tex_coord - 1.0, 1.0, 1.0);

    return output;
}

static const f32x3x3 ACESInputMat = {
    { 0.59719, 0.35458, 0.04823 },
    { 0.07600, 0.90834, 0.01566 },
    { 0.02840, 0.13383, 0.83777 }
};

// ODT_SAT => XYZ => D60_2_D65 => sRGB
static const f32x3x3 ACESOutputMat = {
    { 1.60475, -0.53108, -0.07367 },
    { -0.10208, 1.10813, -0.00605 },
    { -0.00327, -0.07276, 1.07602 }
};

f32x3 RRTAndODTFit(f32x3 v) {
    f32x3 a = v * (v + 0.0245786f) - 0.000090537f;
    f32x3 b = v * (0.983729f * v + 0.4329510f) + 0.238081f;
    return a / b;
}

// ACES Filmic (Fitted)
f32x3 ACES_Fitted(f32x3 color) {
    color = mul(ACESInputMat, color);

    // Apply RRT and ODT
    color = RRTAndODTFit(color);

    color = mul(ACESOutputMat, color);

    // Clamp to [0, 1]
    color = saturate(color);

    return color;
}

float luminance_from_col(float3 color) {
    return dot(color, com::REC709_TO_XYZ_MAT[1]);
}

float3 agxDefaultContrastApproximation(float3 x)
{
    float3 x2 = x * x;
    float3 x4 = x2 * x2;
    return +15.5 * x4 * x2 - 40.14 * x4 * x + 31.96 * x4 - 6.868 * x2 * x + 0.4298 * x2 + 0.1191 * x - 0.00232;
}
void agxLook(inout float3 color)
{
    const float3 slope      = (1.0f).xxx;
    const float3 power      = (1.1f).xxx;
    const float saturation  = 1.3;
    float luma = luminance_from_col(color);
    color = pow(color * slope, power);
    color = max(luma + saturation * (color - luma), float3(0.0));
}
float3 agx_tonemapping(float3 color) {
    // AgX constants
    const float3x3 AgXInsetMatrix = transpose(float3x3(
        float3(0.856627153315983, 0.137318972929847, 0.11189821299995),
        float3(0.0951212405381588, 0.761241990602591, 0.0767994186031903),
        float3(0.0482516061458583, 0.101439036467562, 0.811302368396859)));
    // explicit AgXOutsetMatrix generated from Filaments AgXOutsetMatrixInv
    const float3x3 AgXOutsetMatrix = transpose(float3x3(
        float3(1.1271005818144368, -0.1413297634984383, -0.14132976349843826),
        float3(-0.11060664309660323, 1.157823702216272, -0.11060664309660294),
        float3(-0.016493938717834573, -0.016493938717834257, 1.2519364065950405)));
    const float3x3 LINEAR_REC2020_TO_LINEAR_SRGB =
        transpose(float3x3(float3(1.6605, -0.1246, -0.0182), float3(-0.5876, 1.1329, -0.1006), float3(-0.0728, -0.0083, 1.1187)));
    const float3x3 LINEAR_SRGB_TO_LINEAR_REC2020 =
        transpose(float3x3(float3(0.6274, 0.0691, 0.0164), float3(0.3293, 0.9195, 0.0880), float3(0.0433, 0.0113, 0.8956)));

    // LOG2_MIN      = -10.0
    // LOG2_MAX      =  +6.5
    // MIDDLE_GRAY   =  0.18
    const float AgxMinEv = -12.47393; // log2( pow( 2, LOG2_MIN ) * MIDDLE_GRAY )
    const float AgxMaxEv = 4.026069; // log2( pow( 2, LOG2_MAX ) * MIDDLE_GRAY )
    color = mul(LINEAR_SRGB_TO_LINEAR_REC2020, color);
    color = mul(AgXInsetMatrix, color);
    // Log2 encoding
    color = max(color, 1e-10); // avoid 0 or negative numbers for log2
    color = log2(color);
    color = (color - AgxMinEv) / (AgxMaxEv - AgxMinEv);
    color = clamp(color, 0.0, 1.0);
    // Apply sigmoid
    color = agxDefaultContrastApproximation(color);
    // Apply AgX look
    agxLook(color);
    color = mul(AgXOutsetMatrix, color);
    // Linearize
    color = pow(max(float3(0.0), color), float3(2.2));
    color = mul(LINEAR_REC2020_TO_LINEAR_SRGB, color);
    // Gamut mapping. Simple clamp for now.
    color = clamp(color, 0.0, 1.0);
    return color;
}

f32x3x3 inverse(f32x3x3 m)
{
    f32 a = m[0].x, b = m[0].y, c = m[0].z;
    f32 d = m[1].x, e = m[1].y, f = m[1].z;
    f32 g = m[2].x, h = m[2].y, i = m[2].z;

    f32 A =  (e * i - f * h);
    f32 B = -(d * i - f * g);
    f32 C =  (d * h - e * g);
    f32 D = -(b * i - c * h);
    f32 E =  (a * i - c * g);
    f32 F = -(a * h - b * g);
    f32 G =  (b * f - c * e);
    f32 H = -(a * f - c * d);
    f32 I =  (a * e - b * d);

    f32 det = a * A + b * B + c * C;
    f32 invDet = 1.0 / det;

    return f32x3x3(
        A * invDet, D * invDet, G * invDet,
        B * invDet, E * invDet, H * invDet,
        C * invDet, F * invDet, I * invDet
    );
}

f32x3 color_XyYToXYZ(f32x3 xyY)
{
    f32 Y = xyY.z;
    f32 X = (xyY.x * Y) / xyY.y;
    f32 Z = ((1.0 - xyY.x - xyY.y) * Y) / xyY.y;
    return f32x3(X, Y, Z);
}

f32x3 color_Unproject(f32x2 xy)
{
    return color_XyYToXYZ(f32x3(xy.x, xy.y, 1.0));
}

f32x3x3 color_PrimariesToMatrix(f32x2 xy_red, f32x2 xy_green, f32x2 xy_blue, f32x2 xy_white)
{
    f32x3 XYZ_red   = color_Unproject(xy_red);
    f32x3 XYZ_green = color_Unproject(xy_green);
    f32x3 XYZ_blue  = color_Unproject(xy_blue);
    f32x3 XYZ_white = color_Unproject(xy_white);

    // Rows here = GLSL's columns (see gotcha above).
    f32x3x3 temp = f32x3x3(
        XYZ_red.x, XYZ_green.x, XYZ_blue.x,
        1.0,       1.0,         1.0,
        XYZ_red.z, XYZ_green.z, XYZ_blue.z
    );
    f32x3 scale = mul(inverse(temp), XYZ_white);

    // Same story: rows = GLSL's columns.
    return f32x3x3(
        XYZ_red.x * scale.x, XYZ_green.x * scale.y, XYZ_blue.x * scale.z,
        XYZ_red.y * scale.x, XYZ_green.y * scale.y, XYZ_blue.y * scale.z,
        XYZ_red.z * scale.x, XYZ_green.z * scale.y, XYZ_blue.z * scale.z
    );
}

f32x3x3 color_ComputeCompressionMatrix(f32x2 xyR, f32x2 xyG, f32x2 xyB, f32x2 xyW, f32 compression)
{
    f32 scale_factor = 1.0 / (1.0 - compression);
    f32x2 R = lerp(xyW, xyR, scale_factor);
    f32x2 G = lerp(xyW, xyG, scale_factor);
    f32x2 B = lerp(xyW, xyB, scale_factor);
    f32x2 W = xyW;

    return color_PrimariesToMatrix(R, G, B, W);
}

f32 color_DualSection(f32 x, f32 linear, f32 peak)
{
    // Length of linear section
    f32 S = peak * linear;
    if (x < S)
    {
        return x;
    }
    else
    {
        f32 C = peak / (peak - S);
        return peak - (peak - S) * exp((-C * (x - S)) / peak);
    }
}

f32x3 color_DualSection(f32x3 x, f32 linear, f32 peak)
{
    x.x = color_DualSection(x.x, linear, peak);
    x.y = color_DualSection(x.y, linear, peak);
    x.z = color_DualSection(x.z, linear, peak);
    return x;
}

f32x3 AgX_DS(f32x3 color_srgb)
{
    const let AGX_SATURATION = 1.3;
    const let AGX_COMPRESSION = 0.15;
    const let AGX_LINEAR = 0.10;
    const let AGX_PEAK = 1.0;
    f32x3 workingColor = max(color_srgb, 0.0);

    f32x3x3 sRGB_to_XYZ = color_PrimariesToMatrix(
        f32x2(0.64, 0.33),
        f32x2(0.3, 0.6),
        f32x2(0.15, 0.06),
        f32x2(0.3127, 0.3290));

    f32x3x3 adjusted_to_XYZ = color_ComputeCompressionMatrix(
        f32x2(0.64, 0.33),
        f32x2(0.3, 0.6),
        f32x2(0.15, 0.06),
        f32x2(0.3127, 0.3290),
        AGX_COMPRESSION);

    f32x3x3 XYZ_to_adjusted = inverse(adjusted_to_XYZ);
    f32x3x3 sRGB_to_adjusted = mul(sRGB_to_XYZ, XYZ_to_adjusted);

    workingColor = mul(sRGB_to_adjusted, workingColor);
    workingColor = clamp(color_DualSection(workingColor, AGX_LINEAR, AGX_PEAK), 0.0, 1.0);

    f32x3 luminanceWeight = f32x3(0.2126729, 0.7151522, 0.0721750);
    f32x3 desaturation = f32x3(dot(workingColor, luminanceWeight));
    workingColor = lerp(desaturation, workingColor, AGX_SATURATION);
    workingColor = clamp(workingColor, 0.0, 1.0);

    workingColor = mul(inverse(sRGB_to_adjusted), workingColor);

    return workingColor;
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Mode options.
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#define TONE_MAPPING_UCS_ICTCP  0
#define TONE_MAPPING_UCS_JZAZBZ 1
#define TONE_MAPPING_UCS        TONE_MAPPING_UCS_ICTCP

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Defines the SDR reference white level used in our tone mapping (typically 250 nits).
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#define GRAN_TURISMO_SDR_PAPER_WHITE 250.0f // cd/m^2

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Gran Turismo luminance-scale conversion helpers.
// In Gran Turismo, 1.0f in the linear frame-buffer space corresponds to
// REFERENCE_LUMINANCE cd/m^2 of physical luminance (typically 100 cd/m^2).
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#define REFERENCE_LUMINANCE 100.0f // cd/m^2 <-> 1.0f

float
frameBufferValueToPhysicalValue(float fbValue)
{
    // Converts linear frame-buffer value to physical luminance (cd/m^2)
    // where 1.0 corresponds to REFERENCE_LUMINANCE (e.g., 100 cd/m^2).
    return fbValue * REFERENCE_LUMINANCE;
}

float
physicalValueToFrameBufferValue(float physical)
{
    // Converts physical luminance (cd/m^2) to a linear frame-buffer value,
    // where 1.0 corresponds to REFERENCE_LUMINANCE (e.g., 100 cd/m^2).
    return physical / REFERENCE_LUMINANCE;
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Utility functions.
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
float
smoothStep(float x, float edge0, float edge1)
{
    float t = (x - edge0) / (edge1 - edge0);

    if (x < edge0)
    {
        return 0.0f;
    }
    if (x > edge1)
    {
        return 1.0f;
    }

    return t * t * (3.0f - 2.0f * t);
}

float
chromaCurve(float x, float a, float b)
{
    return 1.0f - smoothStep(x, a, b);
}


// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// "GT Tone Mapping" curve with convergent shoulder.
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct GTToneMappingCurveV2
{
    float peakIntensity_;
    float alpha_;
    float midPoint_;
    float linearSection_;
    float toeStrength_;
    float kA_, kB_, kC_;

    [mutating]
    void initializeCurve(float monitorIntensity,
                         float alpha,
                         float grayPoint,
                         float linearSection,
                         float toeStrength)
    {
        peakIntensity_ = monitorIntensity;
        alpha_         = alpha;
        midPoint_      = grayPoint;
        linearSection_ = linearSection;
        toeStrength_   = toeStrength;

        // Pre-compute constants for the shoulder region.
        float k = (linearSection_ - 1.0f) / (alpha_ - 1.0f);
        kA_     = peakIntensity_ * linearSection_ + peakIntensity_ * k;
        kB_     = -peakIntensity_ * k * exp(linearSection_ / k);
        kC_     = -1.0f / (k * peakIntensity_);
    }

    float evaluateCurve(float x)
    {
        if (x < 0.0f)
        {
            return 0.0f;
        }

        float weightLinear = smoothStep(x, 0.0f, midPoint_);
        float weightToe    = 1.0f - weightLinear;

        // Shoulder mapping for highlights.
        float shoulder = kA_ + kB_ * exp(x * kC_);

        if (x < linearSection_ * peakIntensity_)
        {
            float toeMapped = midPoint_ * pow(x / midPoint_, toeStrength_);
            return weightToe * toeMapped + weightLinear * x;
        }
        else
        {
            return shoulder;
        }
    }
};

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// EOTF / inverse-EOTF for ST-2084 (PQ).
// Note: Introduce exponentScaleFactor to allow scaling of the exponent in the EOTF for Jzazbz.
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
float
eotfSt2084(float n, float exponentScaleFactor = 1.0f)
{
    if (n < 0.0f)
    {
        n = 0.0f;
    }
    if (n > 1.0f)
    {
        n = 1.0f;
    }

    // Base functions from SMPTE ST 2084:2014
    // Converts from normalized PQ (0-1) to absolute luminance in cd/m^2 (linear light)
    // Assumes float input; does not handle integer encoding (Annex)
    // Assumes full-range signal (0-1)
    const float m1  = 0.1593017578125f;                // (2610 / 4096) / 4
    const float m2  = 78.84375f * exponentScaleFactor; // (2523 / 4096) * 128
    const float c1  = 0.8359375f;                      // 3424 / 4096
    const float c2  = 18.8515625f;                     // (2413 / 4096) * 32
    const float c3  = 18.6875f;                        // (2392 / 4096) * 32
    const float pqC = 10000.0f;                        // Maximum luminance supported by PQ (cd/m^2)

    // Does not handle signal range from 2084 - assumes full range (0-1)
    float np = pow(n, 1.0f / m2);
    float l  = np - c1;

    if (l < 0.0f)
    {
        l = 0.0f;
    }

    l = l / (c2 - c3 * np);
    l = pow(l, 1.0f / m1);

    // Convert absolute luminance (cd/m^2) into the frame-buffer linear scale.
    return physicalValueToFrameBufferValue(l * pqC);
}

float
inverseEotfSt2084(float v, float exponentScaleFactor = 1.0f)
{
    const float m1  = 0.1593017578125f;
    const float m2  = 78.84375f * exponentScaleFactor;
    const float c1  = 0.8359375f;
    const float c2  = 18.8515625f;
    const float c3  = 18.6875f;
    const float pqC = 10000.0f;

    // Convert the frame-buffer linear scale into absolute luminance (cd/m^2).
    float physical = frameBufferValueToPhysicalValue(v);
    float y        = physical / pqC; // Normalize for the ST-2084 curve

    float ym = pow(y, m1);
    return exp2(m2 * (log2(c1 + c2 * ym) - log2(1.0f + c3 * ym)));
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// ICtCp conversion.
// Reference: ITU-T T.302 (https://www.itu.int/rec/T-REC-T.302/en)
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
void
rgbToICtCp(f32x3 rgb, out f32x3 ictCp) // Input: linear Rec.2020
{
    float l = (rgb[0] * 1688.0f + rgb[1] * 2146.0f + rgb[2] * 262.0f) / 4096.0f;
    float m = (rgb[0] * 683.0f + rgb[1] * 2951.0f + rgb[2] * 462.0f) / 4096.0f;
    float s = (rgb[0] * 99.0f + rgb[1] * 309.0f + rgb[2] * 3688.0f) / 4096.0f;

    float lPQ = inverseEotfSt2084(l);
    float mPQ = inverseEotfSt2084(m);
    float sPQ = inverseEotfSt2084(s);

    ictCp[0] = (2048.0f * lPQ + 2048.0f * mPQ) / 4096.0f;
    ictCp[1] = (6610.0f * lPQ - 13613.0f * mPQ + 7003.0f * sPQ) / 4096.0f;
    ictCp[2] = (17933.0f * lPQ - 17390.0f * mPQ - 543.0f * sPQ) / 4096.0f;
}

void
iCtCpToRgb(f32x3 ictCp, out f32x3 rgb) // Output: linear Rec.2020
{
    float l = ictCp[0] + 0.00860904f * ictCp[1] + 0.11103f * ictCp[2];
    float m = ictCp[0] - 0.00860904f * ictCp[1] - 0.11103f * ictCp[2];
    float s = ictCp[0] + 0.560031f * ictCp[1] - 0.320627f * ictCp[2];

    float lLin = eotfSt2084(l);
    float mLin = eotfSt2084(m);
    float sLin = eotfSt2084(s);

    rgb[0] = max(3.43661f * lLin - 2.50645f * mLin + 0.0698454f * sLin, 0.0f);
    rgb[1] = max(-0.79133f * lLin + 1.9836f * mLin - 0.192271f * sLin, 0.0f);
    rgb[2] = max(-0.0259499f * lLin - 0.0989137f * mLin + 1.12486f * sLin, 0.0f);
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Jzazbz conversion.
// Reference:
// Muhammad Safdar, Guihua Cui, Youn Jin Kim, and Ming Ronnier Luo,
// "Perceptually uniform color space for image signals including high dynamic
// range and wide gamut," Opt. Express 25, 15131-15151 (2017)
// Note: Coefficients adjusted for linear Rec.2020
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#define JZAZBZ_EXPONENT_SCALE_FACTOR 1.7f // Scale factor for exponent

void
rgbToJzazbz(f32x3 rgb, out f32x3 jab) // Input: linear Rec.2020
{
    float l = rgb[0] * 0.530004f + rgb[1] * 0.355704f + rgb[2] * 0.086090f;
    float m = rgb[0] * 0.289388f + rgb[1] * 0.525395f + rgb[2] * 0.157481f;
    float s = rgb[0] * 0.091098f + rgb[1] * 0.147588f + rgb[2] * 0.734234f;

    float lPQ = inverseEotfSt2084(l, JZAZBZ_EXPONENT_SCALE_FACTOR);
    float mPQ = inverseEotfSt2084(m, JZAZBZ_EXPONENT_SCALE_FACTOR);
    float sPQ = inverseEotfSt2084(s, JZAZBZ_EXPONENT_SCALE_FACTOR);

    float iz = 0.5f * lPQ + 0.5f * mPQ;

    jab[0] = (0.44f * iz) / (1.0f - 0.56f * iz) - 1.6295499532821566e-11f;
    jab[1] = 3.524000f * lPQ - 4.066708f * mPQ + 0.542708f * sPQ;
    jab[2] = 0.199076f * lPQ + 1.096799f * mPQ - 1.295875f * sPQ;
}

void
jzazbzToRgb(f32x3 jab, out f32x3 rgb) // Output: linear Rec.2020
{
    float jz = jab[0] + 1.6295499532821566e-11f;
    float iz = jz / (0.44f + 0.56f * jz);
    float a  = jab[1];
    float b  = jab[2];

    float l = iz + a * 1.386050432715393e-1f + b * 5.804731615611869e-2f;
    float m = iz + a * -1.386050432715393e-1f + b * -5.804731615611869e-2f;
    float s = iz + a * -9.601924202631895e-2f + b * -8.118918960560390e-1f;

    float lLin = eotfSt2084(l, JZAZBZ_EXPONENT_SCALE_FACTOR);
    float mLin = eotfSt2084(m, JZAZBZ_EXPONENT_SCALE_FACTOR);
    float sLin = eotfSt2084(s, JZAZBZ_EXPONENT_SCALE_FACTOR);

    rgb[0] = lLin * 2.990669f + mLin * -2.049742f + sLin * 0.088977f;
    rgb[1] = lLin * -1.634525f + mLin * 3.145627f + sLin * -0.483037f;
    rgb[2] = lLin * -0.042505f + mLin * -0.377983f + sLin * 1.448019f;
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Unified color space (UCS): ICtCp or Jzazbz.
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#if TONE_MAPPING_UCS == TONE_MAPPING_UCS_ICTCP
void
rgbToUcs(f32x3 rgb, out f32x3 ucs)
{
    rgbToICtCp(rgb, ucs);
}
void
ucsToRgb(f32x3 ucs, out f32x3 rgb)
{
    iCtCpToRgb(ucs, rgb);
}
#elif TONE_MAPPING_UCS == TONE_MAPPING_UCS_JZAZBZ
void
rgbToUcs(f32x3 rgb, out f32x3 ucs)
{
    rgbToJzazbz(rgb, ucs);
}
void
ucsToRgb(f32x3 ucs, out f32x3 rgb)
{
    jzazbzToRgb(ucs, rgb);
}
#else
#error "Unsupported TONE_MAPPING_UCS value. Please define TONE_MAPPING_UCS as either TONE_MAPPING_UCS_ICTCP or TONE_MAPPING_UCS_JZAZBZ."
#endif

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// GT7 Tone Mapping class.
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct GT7ToneMapping
{
    float sdrCorrectionFactor_;

    float framebufferLuminanceTarget_;
    float framebufferLuminanceTargetUcs_; // Target luminance in UCS space
    GTToneMappingCurveV2 curve_;

    float blendRatio_;
    float fadeStart_;
    float fadeEnd_;

    // Initializes the tone mapping curve and related parameters based on the target display luminance.
    // This method should not be called directly. Use initializeAsHDR() or initializeAsSDR() instead.
    [mutating]
    void initializeParameters(float physicalTargetLuminance)
    {
        framebufferLuminanceTarget_ = physicalValueToFrameBufferValue(physicalTargetLuminance);

        // Initialize the curve (slightly different parameters from GT Sport).
        curve_.initializeCurve(framebufferLuminanceTarget_, 0.25f, 0.538f, 0.444f, 1.280f);

        // Default parameters.
        blendRatio_ = 0.6f;
        fadeStart_  = 0.98f;
        fadeEnd_    = 1.16f;

        f32x3 ucs;
        f32x3 rgb = { framebufferLuminanceTarget_,
                      framebufferLuminanceTarget_,
                      framebufferLuminanceTarget_ };
        rgbToUcs(rgb, ucs);
        framebufferLuminanceTargetUcs_ =
            ucs[0]; // Use the first UCS component (I or Jz) as luminance
    }

    // Initialize for HDR (High Dynamic Range) display.
    // Input: target display peak luminance in nits (range: 250 to 10,000)
    // Note: The lower limit is 250 because the parameters for GTToneMappingCurveV2
    //       were determined based on an SDR paper white assumption of 250 nits (GRAN_TURISMO_SDR_PAPER_WHITE).
    [mutating]
    void initializeAsHDR(float physicalTargetLuminance)
    {
        sdrCorrectionFactor_ = 1.0f;
        initializeParameters(physicalTargetLuminance);
    }

    // Initialize for SDR (Standard Dynamic Range) display.
    [mutating]
    void initializeAsSDR()
    {
        // Regarding SDR output:
        // First, in GT (Gran Turismo), it is assumed that a maximum value of 1.0 in SDR output
        // corresponds to GRAN_TURISMO_SDR_PAPER_WHITE (typically 250 nits).
        // Therefore, tone mapping for SDR output is performed based on GRAN_TURISMO_SDR_PAPER_WHITE.
        // However, in the sRGB standard, 1.0f corresponds to 100 nits,
        // so we need to "undo" the tone-mapped values accordingly.
        // To match the sRGB range, the tone-mapped values are scaled using sdrCorrectionFactor_.
        //
        // * These adjustments ensure that the visual appearance (in terms of brightness)
        //   stays generally consistent across both HDR and SDR outputs for the same rendered content.
        sdrCorrectionFactor_ = 1.0f / physicalValueToFrameBufferValue(GRAN_TURISMO_SDR_PAPER_WHITE);
        initializeParameters(GRAN_TURISMO_SDR_PAPER_WHITE);
    }

    // Input:  linear Rec.2020 RGB (frame buffer values)
    // Output: tone-mapped RGB (frame buffer values);
    //         - in SDR mode: mapped to [0, 1], ready for sRGB OETF
    //         - in HDR mode: mapped to [0, framebufferLuminanceTarget_], ready for PQ inverse-EOTF
    // Note: framebufferLuminanceTarget_ represents the display's target peak luminance converted to a frame buffer value.
    //       The returned values are suitable for applying the appropriate OETF to generate final output signal.
    void applyToneMapping(f32x3 rgb, out f32x3 out)
    {
        // Convert to UCS to separate luminance and chroma.
        f32x3 ucs;
        rgbToUcs(rgb, ucs);

        // Per-channel tone mapping ("skewed" color).
        f32x3 skewedRgb = { curve_.evaluateCurve(rgb[0]),
                            curve_.evaluateCurve(rgb[1]),
                            curve_.evaluateCurve(rgb[2]) };

        f32x3 skewedUcs;
        rgbToUcs(skewedRgb, skewedUcs);

        float chromaScale =
            chromaCurve(ucs[0] / framebufferLuminanceTargetUcs_, fadeStart_, fadeEnd_);

        const f32x3 scaledUcs = { skewedUcs[0],         // Luminance from skewed color
                                  ucs[1] * chromaScale, // Scaled chroma components
                                  ucs[2] * chromaScale };

        // Convert back to RGB.
        f32x3 scaledRgb;
        ucsToRgb(scaledUcs, scaledRgb);

        // Final blend between per-channel and UCS-scaled results.
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
        {
            float blended = (1.0f - blendRatio_) * skewedRgb[i] + blendRatio_ * scaledRgb[i];
            // When using SDR, apply the correction factor.
            // When using HDR, sdrCorrectionFactor_ is 1.0f, so it has no effect.
            out[i] = sdrCorrectionFactor_ * min(blended, framebufferLuminanceTarget_);
        }
    }
};

[[shader("fragment")]]
f32x4 fs_main(VertexOutput input) {
    var color = input_image.SampleLevel(sampler, input.tex_coord, 0.0).rgb;

    if ((scene_flags & SceneFlags::HasEyeAdaptation) != 0) {
        let exposure = histogram_luminance.exposure;
        color *= exposure;
    }

    if ((scene_flags & SceneFlags::HasBloom) != 0) {
        let bloom = bloom_image.SampleLevel(sampler, input.tex_coord, 0.0).rgb;
        color += bloom;
    }

    switch (tonemap_type) {
        case TonemapType::ACES: {
            color = ACES_Fitted(color);
        } break;
        case TonemapType::AgX: {
            color = AgX_DS(color);
        } break;
        case TonemapType::GT7: {
            var gt7 = GT7ToneMapping();
            gt7.initializeAsSDR();
            // GT7 tone mapping operates in linear Rec.2020.
            f32x3 rec2020In = com::rec709_to_rec2020(color);
            f32x3 rec2020Out = f32x3(0.0);
            gt7.applyToneMapping(rec2020In, rec2020Out);
            color = com::rec2020_to_rec709(rec2020Out);
        } break;
        default:;
    }

    if ((scene_flags & SceneFlags::HasChromaticAberration) != 0) {
        let rgmag = FfxLensGetRGMag(C.post_process_settings.chromatic_aberration_amount);
        color = FfxLensSampleWithChromaticAberration(input_image, sampler, i32x2(input.position.xy), C.screen_size / 2, rgmag.x, rgmag.y);
    }

    if ((scene_flags & SceneFlags::HasVignette) != 0) {
        FfxLensApplyVignette(i32x2(input.position.xy), C.screen_size / 2, color, C.post_process_settings.vignette_amount);
    }

    if ((scene_flags & SceneFlags::HasFilmGrain) != 0) {
        FfxLensApplyFilmGrain(i32x2(input.position.xy),
        color,
        C.post_process_settings.film_grain_scale,
        C.post_process_settings.film_grain_amount,
        C.post_process_settings.film_grain_seed);
    }

    return f32x4(color, 1.0);
}
```

`Oxylus/src/Render/Shaders/passes/visbuffer_decode.slang`:

```slang
module visbuffer_decode;

import common;
import gpu;
import scene;
import visbuffer;

#include <fullscreen.slang>

struct ShaderParameters {
    ConstantBuffer<Camera> camera;
    StructuredBuffer<MeshletInstance> meshlet_instances;
    StructuredBuffer<MeshInstance> mesh_instances;
    StructuredBuffer<Mesh> meshes;
    StructuredBuffer<TransformWorld> transforms;
    StructuredBuffer<Material> materials;

    Image2D<u32> visbuffer;
};
ParameterBlock<ShaderParameters> params;

struct FragmentOutput {
    f32x4 albedo_color : SV_Target0;
    f32x4 normal_color : SV_Target1;
    f32x3 emission_color : SV_Target2;
    f32x4 metallic_roughness_occlusion_color : SV_Target3;
};

struct PartialDeriv {
    f32x3 ddx;
    f32x3 ddy;
    f32x3 lambda;

    func gradient_of(f32x2x3 v) -> UVGradient {
        UVGradient grad;
        grad.uv = mul(this.lambda, v);
        grad.ddx = mul(this.ddx, v);
        grad.ddy = mul(this.ddy, v);

        return grad;
    }
};

func compute_partial_derivatives(in f32x4x3 world_positions, in f32x2 uv, in f32x2 resolution) -> PartialDeriv {
    PartialDeriv result;

    let clip_pos_0 = mul(params.camera.projection_view, f32x4(world_positions[0].xyz, 1.0));
    let clip_pos_1 = mul(params.camera.projection_view, f32x4(world_positions[1].xyz, 1.0));
    let clip_pos_2 = mul(params.camera.projection_view, f32x4(world_positions[2].xyz, 1.0));

    // Partial Derivatives
    let inv_w = 1.0 / f32x3(clip_pos_0.w, clip_pos_1.w, clip_pos_2.w);
    let ndc_0 = clip_pos_0.xy * inv_w[0];
    let ndc_1 = clip_pos_1.xy * inv_w[1];
    let ndc_2 = clip_pos_2.xy * inv_w[2];
    // Inverse area of a triangle.
    // https://cg.ivd.kit.edu/publications/2015/dais/DAIS.pdf
    // Appendix A:
    // D =
    let inv_det = 1.0 / determinant(f32x2x2(ndc_2 - ndc_1, ndc_0 - ndc_1));
    // Lambda 1 =
    result.ddx = f32x3(ndc_1.y - ndc_2.y, ndc_2.y - ndc_0.y, ndc_0.y - ndc_1.y) * inv_det * inv_w;
    // Lambda 2 =
    result.ddy = f32x3(ndc_2.x - ndc_1.x, ndc_0.x - ndc_2.x, ndc_1.x - ndc_0.x) * inv_det * inv_w;
    var ddx_sum = dot(result.ddx, 1.0);
    var ddy_sum = dot(result.ddy, 1.0);

    let delta_v = uv - ndc_0;
    let interp_inv_w = inv_w.x + delta_v.x * ddx_sum + delta_v.y * ddy_sum;
    let interp_w = 1.0 / interp_inv_w;
    result.lambda = f32x3(
        interp_w * (inv_w[0] + delta_v.x * result.ddx.x + delta_v.y * result.ddy.x),
        interp_w * (delta_v.x * result.ddx.y + delta_v.y * result.ddy.y),
        interp_w * (delta_v.x * result.ddx.z + delta_v.y * result.ddy.z)
    );
    let two_over_resolution = 2.0 / resolution;
    result.ddx *= two_over_resolution.x;
    result.ddy *= -two_over_resolution.y;
    ddx_sum *= two_over_resolution.x;
    ddy_sum *= -two_over_resolution.y;

    let interp_ddx_w = 1.0 / (interp_inv_w + ddx_sum);
    let interp_ddy_w = 1.0 / (interp_inv_w + ddy_sum);
    result.ddx = interp_ddx_w * (result.lambda * interp_inv_w + result.ddx) - result.lambda;
    result.ddy = interp_ddy_w * (result.lambda * interp_inv_w + result.ddy) - result.lambda;

    return result;
}

[[shader("fragment")]]
func fs_main(VertexOutput input) -> FragmentOutput {
    let texel = params.visbuffer.Load(u32x3(u32x2(input.position.xy), 0));
    if (texel == ~0u) {
        discard;
    }

    let vis = VisBufferData(texel);
    let meshlet_instance_index = vis.meshlet_instance_index;
    let meshlet_instance = params.meshlet_instances[meshlet_instance_index];
    let mesh_instance = params.mesh_instances[meshlet_instance.mesh_instance_index];
    let mesh = params.meshes[mesh_instance.mesh_index];
    let material = params.materials[mesh_instance.material_index];
    let transform = params.transforms[mesh_instance.transform_index];
    let mesh_lod = mesh.lods[mesh_instance.lod_index];
    let meshlet = mesh_lod.meshlets[meshlet_instance.meshlet_index];

    FragmentOutput output = {};

    let indices = meshlet.indices(mesh_lod, vis.triangle_index);
    if (any(indices > (mesh.vertex_count - 1))) {
        return output;
    }
    let positions = meshlet.positions(mesh, indices);
    let normals = meshlet.normals(mesh, indices);
    let tex_coords = meshlet.tex_coords(mesh, indices);
    let world_positions = transform.to_world_positions(positions);
    let NDC = f32x3(input.tex_coord * 2.0 - 1.0, 1.0);
    let deriv = compute_partial_derivatives(world_positions, NDC.xy, params.camera.resolution);
    let tex_coord_grad = deriv.gradient_of(tex_coords);

    // ALBEDO
    output.albedo_color = material.sample_albedo_color(tex_coord_grad);

    // NORMALS
    const f32x3x3 camera_relative_world_positions = {
        world_positions[0].xyz - params.camera.position.xyz,
        world_positions[1].xyz - params.camera.position.xyz,
        world_positions[2].xyz - params.camera.position.xyz,
    };
    const f32x3 pos_ddx = mul(deriv.ddx, camera_relative_world_positions);
    const f32x3 pos_ddy = mul(deriv.ddy, camera_relative_world_positions);

    const f32x3x3 world_normals = transform.to_world_normals(normals);
    const f32x3 world_normal = normalize(mul(deriv.lambda, world_normals));

    const f32x3 pos_ddx_s = pos_ddx - dot(pos_ddx, world_normal) * world_normal;
    const f32x3 pos_ddy_s = pos_ddy - dot(pos_ddy, world_normal) * world_normal;
    const f32x2 uv_ddx = tex_coord_grad.ddx;
    const f32x2 uv_ddy = tex_coord_grad.ddy;

    const i32 jacobian_sign = sign(uv_ddx.x * uv_ddy.y - uv_ddx.y * uv_ddy.x);
    f32x3 tangent = jacobian_sign * (uv_ddy.y * pos_ddx_s - uv_ddx.y * pos_ddy_s);
    if (jacobian_sign != 0.0) {
        tangent = normalize(tangent);
    }
    const f32 w = jacobian_sign * sign(dot(pos_ddy, cross(world_normal, pos_ddx)));
    f32x3 bitangent = -w * cross(world_normal, tangent);
    f32x3 normal = world_normal;

#if 1
    const f32 inv_len_N = 1.0 / length(normal);
    tangent *= inv_len_N;
    bitangent *= inv_len_N;
    normal *= inv_len_N;
#endif

    if (material.flags & MaterialFlag::HasNormalImage) {
        f32x3 sampled_normal = material.sample_normal_color(tex_coord_grad);
        // NOTE: This is here to convert tangent spaces to our correct spaces.
        // for example, normal map's R component is +Y for our world. @grok is this true?
        // sampled_normal = f32x3(sampled_normal.y, sampled_normal.x, sampled_normal.z);

        if (material.flags & MaterialFlag::NormalTwoComponent) {
            sampled_normal = f32x3(sampled_normal.yx * 2.0 - 1.0, 0.0);
            sampled_normal.z = sqrt(1.0 - sampled_normal.x * sampled_normal.x - sampled_normal.y * sampled_normal.y);
        } else {
            sampled_normal = sampled_normal * 2.0 - 1.0;
        }

        if (material.flags & MaterialFlag::NormalFlipY) {
            sampled_normal.y = -sampled_normal.y;
        }

        normal = sampled_normal.x * tangent
               + sampled_normal.y * bitangent
               + sampled_normal.z * normal;
        normal = normalize(normal);
    }

    output.normal_color.xy = com::vec3_to_oct(normal);
    output.normal_color.zw = com::vec3_to_oct(world_normal);

    // EMISSION
    output.emission_color = material.sample_emissive_color(tex_coord_grad);

    // METALLIC ROUGHNESS
    const f32x2 metallic_roughness_color = material.sample_metallic_roughness(tex_coord_grad);
    output.metallic_roughness_occlusion_color.xy = metallic_roughness_color;

    const f32 occlusion_color = material.sample_occlusion_color(tex_coord_grad);
    output.metallic_roughness_occlusion_color.z = occlusion_color;

    return output;
}
```

`Oxylus/src/Render/Shaders/passes/visbuffer_encode.slang`:

```slang
import common;
import gpu;
import scene;
import visbuffer;

#include <defines.slang>

[[vk::binding(0)]] ConstantBuffer<Camera> camera;
[[vk::binding(1)]] StructuredBuffer<Mesh> meshes;
[[vk::binding(2)]] StructuredBuffer<MeshInstance> mesh_instances;
[[vk::binding(3)]] StructuredBuffer<MeshletInstance> meshlet_instances;
[[vk::binding(4)]] StructuredBuffer<TransformWorld> transforms;
[[vk::binding(5)]] StructuredBuffer<Material> materials;
[[vk::binding(6)]] StorageImage2D<u32, ImageFormat::R32UI> overdraw;
[[vk::constant_id(0)]] const bool RENDER_OVERDRAW = false;

struct VertexOutput {
    f32x4 position : SV_Position;
    f32x2 tex_coord : TEXCOORD;
    nointerpolation u32 vis_data;
    nointerpolation u32 material_index;
};

[[shader("vertex")]]
func vs_main(u32 vertex_index : SV_VertexID) -> VertexOutput {
    let vis = VisBufferData(vertex_index);
    let meshlet_instance = meshlet_instances[vis.meshlet_instance_index];
    let mesh_instance = mesh_instances[meshlet_instance.mesh_instance_index];
    let mesh = meshes[mesh_instance.mesh_index];
    let mesh_lod = mesh.lods[mesh_instance.lod_index];
    let transform = transforms[mesh_instance.transform_index];
    let meshlet = mesh_lod.meshlets[meshlet_instance.meshlet_index];

    let index = meshlet.index(mesh_lod, vis.triangle_index);
    let vertex_pos = meshlet.position(mesh, index);
    let tex_coord = meshlet.tex_coord(mesh, index);
    let world_pos = transform.to_world_position(vertex_pos);
    let clip_pos = mul(camera.projection_view, f32x4(world_pos.xyz, 1.0));

    let encoded_vis = VisBufferData(vis.meshlet_instance_index, vis.triangle_index / 3);

    VertexOutput output;
    output.position = clip_pos;
    output.tex_coord = tex_coord;
    output.vis_data = encoded_vis.encode();
    output.material_index = mesh_instance.material_index;

    return output;
}

[[shader("fragment")]]
func fs_main(VertexOutput input) -> u32 {
#if 1
    let material = materials[NonUniformResourceIndex(input.material_index)];
    if (HAS_FLAG(material.flags, MaterialFlag::HasAlbedoImage)) {
        UVGradient grad;
        grad.uv = input.tex_coord;
        grad.ddx = ddx(input.tex_coord);
        grad.ddy = ddy(input.tex_coord);
        let alpha_color = material.sample_albedo_color(grad).a;

        // We are doing deferred, blend alpha mode is not supported in this pass.
        if (alpha_color < clamp(material.get_alpha_cutoff(), 0.001, 1.0)) {
            discard;
        }
    }
#endif

    if (RENDER_OVERDRAW) {
        __atomic_add(overdraw[u32x2(input.position.xy)], 1u, MemoryOrder::Relaxed);
    }

    return input.vis_data;
}
```

`Oxylus/src/Render/Shaders/pbr.slang`:

```slang
import common;

public static constexpr f32 MIN_ALPHA = 0.0025;

public f32 perceptual_roughness_to_alpha(f32 perceptual_roughness) {
    let alpha = perceptual_roughness * perceptual_roughness;
    return max(alpha, MIN_ALPHA);
}

public f32 D_GGX(f32 NoH, f32 alpha2) {
    let f = (NoH * alpha2 - NoH) * NoH + 1.0;
    return alpha2 / (PI * f * f + 1e-7);
}

public f32 V_SmithGGXCorrelated(f32 NoV, f32 NoL, f32 alpha2) {
    let GGXV = NoL * sqrt(NoV * NoV * (1.0 - alpha2) + alpha2);
    let GGXL = NoV * sqrt(NoL * NoL * (1.0 - alpha2) + alpha2);
    return saturate(0.5 / (GGXV + GGXL + 1e-7));
}

public f32x3 F_Schlick(f32 LoH, f32x3 F0) {
    return F0 + (1.0 - F0) * pow(saturate(1.0 - LoH), 5.0);
}

public f32x3 F_SchlickRoughness(f32 NoV, f32x3 F0, f32 perceptual_roughness) {
    let F90 = max(f32x3(1.0 - perceptual_roughness), F0);
    return F0 + (F90 - F0) * pow(saturate(1.0 - NoV), 5.0);
}

public constexpr f32 Fd_Lambert() {
    return 1.0 / PI;
}

public func GGX_directional_albedo(f32 NoV, f32 alpha) -> f32x2 {
    let x = NoV;
    let y = alpha;
    let x2 = x * x;
    let y2 = y * y;
    const let r = f32x4(0.1003, 0.9345, 1.0, 1.0) + f32x4(-0.6303, -2.323, -1.765, 0.2281) * x + f32x4(9.748, 2.229, 8.263, 15.94) * y
        + f32x4(-2.038, -3.748, 11.53, -55.83) * x * y + f32x4(29.34, 1.424, 28.96, 13.08) * x2 + f32x4(-8.245, -0.7684, -7.507, 41.26) * y2
        + f32x4(-26.44, 1.436, -36.11, 54.9) * x2 * y + f32x4(19.99, 0.2913, 15.86, 300.2) * x * y2 + f32x4(-5.448, 0.6286, 33.37, -285.1) * x2 * y2;
    return clamp(r.xy / r.zw, 0.0, 1.0);
}

public f32x3 GGX_energy_compensation(f32 NoV, f32 alpha, f32x3 Fss) {
    let AB = GGX_directional_albedo(NoV, alpha);
    let Ess = saturate(AB.x + AB.y);
    return 1.0 + Fss * (1.0 - Ess) / max(Ess, 1e-4);
}

public f32 specular_occlusion_horizon(f32 NoV, f32 ao, f32 perceptual_roughness) {
    return saturate(pow(NoV + ao, exp2(-16.0 * perceptual_roughness - 1.0)) - 1.0 + ao);
}

public struct BRDFResult {
    public f32x3 diffuse;
    public f32x3 specular;
};

public func BRDF(f32x3 V, f32x3 N, f32x3 L, f32x3 albedo, f32 perceptual_roughness, f32 metallic) -> BRDFResult {
    let VL = V + L;
    let H = dot(VL, VL) > 1e-8 ? normalize(VL) : N;
    let NoV = abs(dot(N, V)) + 1e-5;
    let NoL = saturate(dot(N, L));
    let NoH = saturate(dot(N, H));
    let LoH = saturate(dot(L, H));

    let dielectric_F0 = f32x3(0.04);
    let F0 = lerp(dielectric_F0, albedo, metallic);

    let alpha = perceptual_roughness_to_alpha(perceptual_roughness);
    let alpha2 = alpha * alpha;

    let D = D_GGX(NoH, alpha2);
    let Vis = V_SmithGGXCorrelated(NoV, NoL, alpha2);
    let F = F_Schlick(LoH, F0);
    let energy_compensation = GGX_energy_compensation(NoV, alpha, F0);

    BRDFResult result;
    result.specular = D * Vis * F * energy_compensation;

    let kd = (1.0 - metallic) * (1.0 - F);
    result.diffuse = kd * albedo * Fd_Lambert();

    return result;
}
```

`Oxylus/src/Render/Shaders/raymarch.slang`:

```slang
// Copyright (c) 2023 Tomasz Stachowiak
//
// This contribution is dual licensed under EITHER OF
//
//     Apache License, Version 2.0, (http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0)

//
```
